$comment: Tower building (round 09, owner 2026-10-12; numbers = Claude's proposal, approved with 'hepsini önerdiğin gibi'). Missions only. A player builds a tower into one of the dormant slots (the mission's `build.slots` reserve towers) about `ahead` tiles in front of the hull, inside his own zone: closer to his own base than to the enemy base by at least `zoneMargin` tiles. The tower rises for `buildTime` s (invulnerable, silent).
